label: YouTuber Rules

source.review: Full narration and visual demonstrations reviewed, including the Blue Infantry correction at 28:18–28:22.

appClarifications: Red starts. The source gives no first-player procedure.
Eligible cargo may board without an invented three-piece or per-type quota. The finite 19-piece army bounds any stack. Every descendant must be eligible for its parent and the root carrier.
Only movement onto the carrier boards. Carrier pickup and passenger drop-and-return remain available in earlier profiles but are not video-confirmed actions here.

Every original stack member acts at most once per turn. Navy may instead use each of its sea and land weapons once; ranges are measured from its current position after the first shot. Newly boarding ends the turn.
Navy can pass occupied water points as in the existing engine; the video does not separately settle this obstruction case.

Passengers remaining aboard are lost when their carrier is destroyed. Interception losses score for the defending side. Destroying HQ with a weak attacker leaves its Commander alive and the attacker in place.
Last defender means the last living mobile army unit other than Commander or Headquarters; passengers count.
Hero Artillery gains one step under the general bonus. Commander keeps the existing general Hero bonus; the video does not demonstrate its special case.
Ordinary flight that encounters defended airspace is intercepted. A defended destination permits the shown successful sacrifice, even when an earlier zone was crossed. Hero Aircraft is immune.

The Commander must be safe after each component action. Automatic forced capture is proved only within a bounded full-turn escape search; when uncertain play continues and players can concede an agreed result.
Simultaneous division elimination gives the acting side its completed victory before its own division loss, retaining the existing engine ordering.

The optional 10/15-minute clock is for the whole match. Tied points draw. The 200 Commander-mate bonus requires a strict captured-point lead; no Commander 100, Hero premium or general mate bonus is added.
Secret deployment uses empty, unstacked intersections within each side’s five home rows, with terrain restrictions; both armies reveal only after both confirm.
